name: Morrowind (OpenMW)
description: Native PS5 homebrew port of OpenMW 0.51.0 for The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind. Features 1080p rendering, DualSense movement and camera controls, controller-friendly menus, native PS5 on-screen keyboard, audio, inventory and save/load support with a larger TV-friendly interface. Requires your own Morrowind, Tribunal and Bloodmoon game data; no original game files are included.
author: mshivam019
